tripod.speaker: object
tripod.text: Tripods in ancient Greece played sacred role.

tripod.speaker: object
tripod.text: Ancient Greeks believed that their fates were firmly in the hands of the gods, who needed to be pleased and appeased through offerings and sacrifices at their temples.

tripod.speaker: object
tripod.text: The priest or priestess put a cauldron on the tripod, lit a fire under it, and then you placed your ritual offerings in the cauldron—maybe grain, animal flesh, oil or wine.
